[[Khabuus]] is one of the two boss-like [[Heket]] foes that can be found at the end of the [[Bogroot Growths]] [[dungeon]].

==Locations==
*[[Depths of Tyria]]
**{{NPC location|Bogroot Growths}} (during [[Giriff's War]])

==Quests==
*[[Giriff's War]]
*[[Khabuus (Zaishen quest)]]

==Skills==
(20 [[Domination Magic]] in [[Hard mode]])
*{{skill icon|Chaos Storm}}
*{{skill icon|Energy Surge}} ([[elite]])
*{{skill icon|Overload}}
*{{skill icon|Power Spike}}
*{{skill icon|Spiritual Pain}}
*{{monster skill icon|Tongue Whip}}

==Notes==
*Khabuus has +5 [[health regeneration]] in [[hard mode]].
*Defeating him completes [[Giriff's War]] and spawns a [[Bogroot Chest]].

==Trivia==
*Kabuus means nightmare in Arabic.
*This NPC is a reference to the character [[w:Caboose (Red vs. Blue)|Caboose]] from the online [[w:machinima|machinima]] series [[w:Red vs. blue|Red vs. Blue]].
